export_components.name: C-CDA (USCDI v1)
export_components.description: C-CDA document in compliance with USCDI v1. Standard clinical summary covering problems, medications, allergies, immunizations, vitals, lab results, and procedures.
export_components.notes: Standard C-CDA — no vendor-specific extensions or data dictionary provided.

export_components.name: Demographics
export_components.description: Patient demographics exported as a PDF document.
export_components.notes: PDF is not a computable format per (b)(10) requirements.

export_components.name: Scanned Documents
export_components.description: Scanned documents from the patient record.

export_components.name: Clinical Notes / Lab Results
export_components.description: Clinical notes and lab results exported as a PDF document.
export_components.notes: PDF is not a computable format. Lab results in PDF lose discrete data.

notes: The documentation provides no data dictionary, no field-level detail, no schema, and no sample data. The only structured content is the list of 4 export components (C-CDA XML, demographics PDF, scanned documents, clinical notes/lab results PDF). Of these, only the C-CDA is computable, and its content is defined by the USCDI v1 / C-CDA standard — no vendor-specific extensions or mappings are documented.
